dct_description_sm: This dataset was extracted from the 50-member Large-Ensemble Canadian Regional Climate Model (CanRCM4-LE) (Scinocca et al., 2015), North American region 0.44°  horizontal grid resolution (NAM-44) model runs. Basin averaged means for nine river basins in Western Canada consisting of three variables: mean daily temperature (tas: K); precipitation (pr: kg m-2 s-1); and surface snow amount (snw: kg m-2) are provided.
dct_title_s: Basin averaged CanRCM4 variables for Western Canada
